abrdn III ICAV - Prospectus Update - Effective 15 September 2026
abrdn Future Raw Materials UCITS ETF - Supplement Update - Effective 15 September 2026
abrdn Future Real Estate UCITS ETF - Supplement Update - Effective 15 September 2026
abrdn III ICAV has issued shareholder notices in relation to changes to the abrdn Future Raw Materials UCITS ETF and the abrdn Future Real Estate UCITS ETF.

For the abrdn Future Raw Materials UCITS ETF, the minimum subscription, holding and redemption amounts will be reduced from 1,000,000 shares to 500,000 shares, or the cash equivalent in the relevant Class Currency.

For the abrdn Future Real Estate UCITS ETF, the Aberdeen Investments ESG House Score will be replaced with a new Overall Sustainability Assessment (OSA), and the Fund's Sustainable Investment methodology will be updated.
The changes will take effect on 15 September 2026.
An electronic copy of the Prospectus and Supplement will be available to download from the Aberdeen Investments website Fund Centre | View all funds | Aberdeen on 15 September 2026.
